parts.text: 7 This question is about acids, bases and salts.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Crystals of zinc chloride can be made by warming excess solid zinc oxide with dilute hydrochloric acid. ZnO(s) + 2HCl (aq) → ZnCl 2 (aq) + H 2 O(.......)

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Complete the symbol equation by adding the state symbol for water at room temperature. [1]

ms.text:

parts.text: (b) Choose from the list the ion that is present in all acids. Draw a circle around your chosen answer. Cl – H + O 2– OH – [1]

parts.text: (c) The reaction of zinc oxide with hydrochloric acid is exothermic.
